scope: Finite-rate burned-gas H/O/CO/N subnetwork sensitivity at the same recorded density, composition and conserved internal energy. Uses the retained GRI-Mech high-T elementary reactions among 16 core species, with NASA TM-4513 N2/Ar thermodynamics; it is not the complete 53-species GRI mechanism or fresh n-heptane spray oxidation. Trace heptane is inert. Thermodynamic fit coverage does not validate high-pressure kinetic extrapolation. Closed relaxation is not the coupled flow trajectory.
